rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Service enterprises need a licence, legal capital and a deposit; they answer for their own obligations and must settle the worker's rights if the employer defaults in some cases, but no general joint liability with the employer is written in the Law.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: Service fees are capped (in general one month's salary per 12 months, at most three months' salary) and must be agreed after the supply contract is signed; the 2020 Law removed the worker's duty to refund brokerage commissions; the fee cap is zero for Japan under the 2024 amendment.
rules.s: Law 69/2020 Art. 23; Circular 21/2021 as amended by Circular 02/2024 and Circular 09/2026

rules.v: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
rules.n: A written contract with statutory minimum content is required, and the supply contract must be registered with or approved by the authority before workers are recruited.

rules.v: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
rules.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
rules.n: Orientation education with a completion certificate is compulsory before departure; the cost may be collected from the worker.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: Workers and enterprises contribute to the Overseas Employment Support Fund, which supports workers who die, are injured or must return early and funds legal support; social insurance also applies.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
rules.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
rules.n: The Law provides for labor management sections in missions in countries receiving Vietnamese workers.

rules.v: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
rules.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
rules.n: Complaints go to the authority, which can sanction enterprises and order refunds; compensation claims go to the courts.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
rules.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
rules.n: Minimum age 18; the Law lists prohibited jobs and areas (for example some jobs in nightlife and in conflict zones), sex-neutral on their face.
rules.s: Law 69/2020 Art. 7, Appendix (prohibited jobs and areas)

rules.v: A statute assigns a public body the duty to provide reintegration services (employment, financial, psychosocial) to returning workers
rules.vi: Undang-undang memberi badan publik kewajiban menyediakan layanan reintegrasi (kerja, keuangan, psikososial) bagi pekerja yang pulang
rules.n: The state supports returning workers with job counseling, referral and self-employment loans through employment service centers.

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: No shelters documented
rules.vi: Tidak ada tempat penampungan yang terdokumentasi
rules.n: No dedicated shelters at missions were documented; labor management sections assist workers.

rules.v: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
rules.vi: Saluran resmi ada tetapi tidak 24 jam, atau hanya di sebagian perwakilan
rules.n: The Department of Overseas Labor and missions operate hotlines; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

rules.v: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
rules.vi: Undang-undang menyediakan atau membiayai bantuan hukum bagi pekerja di luar negeri, termasuk dalam perkara pidana dan perdata
rules.n: The Overseas Employment Support Fund can fund legal support for workers abroad.

rules.v: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
rules.vi: Langkah khusus gender bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program
rules.n: The Law applies a general principle of gender equality; no specific duty on violence against women migrant workers was found.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: The Support Fund pays death support and repatriation costs; no independent examination route was found.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
rules.vi: UU khusus memidanakan perdagangan orang untuk kerja paksa dan menyediakan bantuan, pelindungan atau restitusi bagi korban
rules.n: A dedicated Law on Human Trafficking Prevention and Combat (2011) with victim support; a new law adopted in 2024 replaces it (in force 2025, to be confirmed).
rules.s: Law 66/2011/QH12; Law on Prevention and Combat of Human Trafficking 2024

rules.v: Attachés in some destinations, few or no shelters
rules.vi: Atase di sebagian tujuan, sedikit atau tanpa rumah aman
rules.n: Labor attachés in some destinations.
